parts.text: I keep drones and charging equipment in working order, and I handle tasks like adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, and setting up charging pads at our sites. I also take drones out of service for repairs, put them back when they are ready, and send drones to charge. My notes do not state what the very first thing I do is when I arrive at the start of a shift, or how the rest of my day unfolds.
